rejected_recommendation.evidence_assessment: The supplied evidence (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) is a high-level consensus guidance that defines required elements for EV identity, potency, and CMC. It does not constitute program-specific validated analytics, MCB/WCB records, stability- or potency-validation reports, or GMP-like batch comparability data for SGL-001. Consequently, confidence in program-level assertions about identity, potency, or cross-species intact-EV delivery is low.
findings: Only a consensus guidance (MISEV2023) was supplied; no program-specific manufacturing, analytic validation, potency, or batch comparability data for SGL-001 were provided.

MISEV2023 supports the need for orthogonal EV characterization, MCB/WCB reporting, validated intact-EV analytics, stability-indicating potency assays, and cross-batch comparability prior to attributing in vivo signals to intact EVs.

Because program-specific data are absent, claims that SGL-001 is sufficiently characterized (identity, potency, lot-to-lot comparability) or that rodent intranasal biodistribution predicts intact-EV CNS exposure in larger species are unsupported.
objections: MISEV2023 is prescriptive guidance, not program data; it does not demonstrate that SGL-001 manufacturing, analytics, potency, or comparability requirements have been met.
No MCB/WCB generation or characterization records were provided to support source-cell identity or stability claims.
No validated intact-EV analytical method reports (LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy) were provided to support identity/quantification assertions.
No validated, stability-indicating potency assay correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint was provided.
No representative release, stability, or potency comparability data across GMP-like batches were provided to support lot-to-lot consistency claims.

claim_updates.rationale: Only MISEV2023 guidance was supplied; no program-specific validated analytics, potency assays, or batch comparability data were provided to support this claim.
claim_updates.statement: SGL-001 meets required orthogonal EV characterization, validated analytics, and CMC comparability for identity and potency.

claim_updates.rationale: MISEV2023 recommends transparent reporting of source-cell and manufacturing information, but no MCB/WCB records, process descriptions, scale-up run reports, or batch records were provided.
claim_updates.statement: Source-cell MCB/WCB generation and scalable GMP-like manufacturing for SGL-001 have been completed and characterized.

claim_updates.rationale: MISEV2023 supports the need for orthogonal intact-EV readouts and bridging controls for cross-species interpretation; no program-specific orthogonal intact-EV biodistribution data in larger species were supplied.
claim_updates.statement: Rodent intranasal biodistribution data alone predict intact-EV CNS exposure in larger species for SGL-001.

decision_update.question: Proceed with cross-species biodistribution and formulation advancement for SGL-001?
decision_update.rationale: Major advancement requires program-specific CMC and analytic validation deliverables per MISEV recommendations. Human approval required after review of Stage-1 deliverables.

proposed_changes.editorial_clarification: References to MISEV2023 should be presented as guidance-based requirements, not as program-specific evidence that criteria have been met.

hypothesis_update.rationale: Absent validated analytics, MCB/WCB records, potency correlation, and batch comparability, biodistribution signals cannot be reliably attributed to intact EVs nor used for cross-species prediction.
hypothesis_update.statement: A validated Stage-1 CMC/analytics package is required to gate interpretation of intact-EV biodistribution and to enable cross-species bridging.
hypothesis_update.test_plan: Deliver validated intact-EV analytics and potency assay with in vivo PD correlation; produce ≥3 GMP-like batches and demonstrate release, stability, and potency comparability; perform orthogonal intact-EV biodistribution bridging in a larger species with recovery controls.

proposed_changes.next_action: Execute Stage-1 CMC/analytics package: 1) Generate and qualify source-cell MCB/WCB and provide characterization reports. 2) Define an orthogonal QC panel (particle counts, protein/lipid markers, EV-specific markers) and develop fit-for-purpose intact-EV assays; validate LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy. 3) Develop and validate a stability-indicating potency assay and demonstrate correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint. 4) Manufacture ≥3 GMP-like batches and deliver release, stability, and potency comparability data. 5) Provide formulation/device compatibility recovery data (ex vivo and in vivo controls). Estimated: ~3 months to finalize plans and begin execution; full completion depends on assay development.

risk_updates.description: Lack of program-specific validated analytics, potency assay, and batch comparability risks misattributing biological effects to uncontrolled product variability.
risk_updates.mitigation: Execute Stage-1 CMC/analytics package as described; validate assays and demonstrate comparability across ≥3 GMP-like batches before advancing.
risk_updates.title: Insufficient identity and potency characterization

risk_updates.description: Rodent intranasal biodistribution without orthogonal intact-EV readouts or larger-species bridging may not predict CNS exposure in larger species.
risk_updates.mitigation: Require orthogonal intact-EV biodistribution readouts and recovery controls; perform bridging studies in a larger species only after validated analytics and batch comparability are demonstrated.
risk_updates.title: Unproven cross-species intact-EV CNS delivery

risk_updates.description: Without a validated potency assay linked to an in vivo PD endpoint, efficacy signals may not translate across batches or species.
risk_updates.mitigation: Develop and validate a stability-indicating potency assay and demonstrate correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint; incorporate into release and comparability testing.
risk_updates.title: Model generalizability and potency readout uncertainty

rejected_recommendation.recommendation: Do not proceed to cross-species bridging or formulation advancement until the Stage-1 CMC/analytics package is executed and evidence is generated per MISEV recommendations. Required deliverables: MCB/WCB records and characterization; validated orthogonal intact-EV assays (with LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy); a validated, stability-indicating potency assay with in vivo PD correlation; release/stability/potency comparability data across ≥3 GMP-like batches; and formulation/device compatibility recovery data (ex vivo and in vivo controls). Compile results for a regulatory pre-IND/Scientific Advice briefing. Human approval is required for major program advancement decisions; set decision to pending.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Unsupported: MISEV2023 provides consensus recommendations for orthogonal EV characterization, transparent production reporting, and controls to distinguish EVs from non-vesicular particles (ev-misev2023-quality-framework). The supplied evidence is a guidance document and does not include program-specific documentation (e.g., MCB/WCB records, validated intact-EV assay reports, stability-indicating potency assay data, or GMP-like batch comparability) required to support program claims about intact-EV identity, potency, or lot-to-lot comparability. Therefore the program-specific assertions in the original conclusion are unsupported by the supplied evidence.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Program-specific documentation of MCB/WCB generation and characterization; validated intact-EV assay reports (including LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy); stability-indicating potency assay development and correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint; and GMP-like batch comparability data are missing.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Unsupported: MISEV2023 recommends transparent reporting of production and separation/characterization from non-vesicular particles, but the supplied evidence is guidance only and does not include program manufacturing data. The program-specific manufacturing claims (e.g., demonstrated scale-up reproducibility, MCB/WCB generation, batch comparability) are not supported by the provided evidence (ev-misev2023-quality-framework).
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Absence of manufacturing development data (process descriptions, scale-up runs, in-process controls, release specifications, batch records) to confirm reproducible GMP-like manufacture.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Unsupported: The MISEV2023 guidance (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports the need for orthogonal characterization, appropriate controls, and transparent reporting to attribute in vivo signals to intact EVs and to enable cross-species interpretation. However, because only the guidance document is supplied and no program-specific empirical data or validated assays are provided, program claims that rodent intranasal biodistribution predicts intact-EV CNS exposure in larger species, or that materials are sufficiently characterized for formulation advancement, are not supported by the supplied evidence.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Program-specific analytic validation, stability, potency correlation, and cross-batch comparability data are absent.

verification_objections: Program-specific documentation that SGL-001 source‑cell MCB/WCB have been generated and characterized is not provided in the supplied evidence.
Validated intact‑EV analytical method reports for SGL-001 (including LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy) are not present in the supplied evidence.
A validated, stability‑indicating potency assay for SGL-001 and demonstrated correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint are not provided in the supplied evidence.
Representative release, stability, and potency comparability data across 6 GMP‑like batches for SGL-001 are not provided in the supplied evidence.
Formulation/device compatibility recovery data (ex vivo and/or in vivo controls) for SGL-001 are not provided in the supplied evidence.
Empirical program data demonstrating that rodent intranasal biodistribution reliably predicts intact‑EV CNS exposure in larger species are not provided in the supplied evidence.
